Prior instructions remain valid. Repair the applicability and evidence logic: bind the required calculation case to the linked localFrameSectionCalculationCase/member relationship rather than using an unbound ?calculationCase that searches globally. The current local-frame SPARQL also checks only interpolation endpoints, omits the required plasticNeutralAxisHeight result, and its NOT EXISTS condition can produce accidental passes or failures. Encode the area-exceeds condition and 20<framingAngleOmega<70 branch against the linked member and plating, and require the linked calculation case to contain both interpolation endpoints with their coordinate/result values and the conditional plasticNeutralAxisHeight evidence when applicable. The CalculationCaseShape SPARQL is inverted: it selects cases that already have endpoints instead of selecting applicable cases missing required evidence; make it a violation query or replace it with bounded conditional SHACL structure. Do not make interpolation endpoints unconditionally mandatory for non-oblique or non-area-exceeding cases. Require declared relationship paths where the contract requires them, including the ship-to-calculationCase and structuralMember-to-localFrameSectionCalculationCase links, without relocating properties from their authoritative owners.

Remove the unconditional sh:minCount 1/sh:maxCount 1 constraint on loadCase nltl:loadPatchOrientation. The requirement makes patch-load orientation applicable to bottom structural members only; the current LoadCaseShape incorrectly requires that relationship for side-member load cases as well. Preserve the bottom-member conditional orientation check, the side-member transverseFrameOrientation=true branch, all authoritative owner paths, the demand <= plasticStrength comparison, and the tolerance-scaled comparison against the expected midspanPlasticCollapseLoad.

The FILTER currently selects compliant table branches as violations, reversing the logic: rewrite every applicable branch to fail when requiredHullStructuralSteelGrade is absent or differs from the exact expected grade, and rewrite every NOT_APPLICABLE branch to fail when any required grade is supplied. In particular, enforce NOT_APPLICABLE for steelMaterialClassThree with normalStrengthSteelCategory and PC1-3/PC4-5 in thickness bands (35,40], (40,45], and (45,50], with PC1-5 NOT_APPLICABLE in (45,50]; only PC6-7 require E there. Explicitly fail missing polarClass, asBuiltPlateThickness, steelMaterialClass, steelStrengthCategory, tableReference, or wrong table/unit. Keep actual-versus-required rank failure restricted to the matching normal/high-tensile grade family, and ensure missing actual/rank/required values fail where applicable. The embedded unit: prefix is now declared, so retain that declaration.

Also constrain nltl:interpolationPointResult as a QUDT quantity value consistently with its canonical QuantityProperty range, without inventing a datatype or unit.
